design_change: Add bounded pinned framework import observation after stdlib/source-check baseline; the earlier no-framework draft was the reviewer's narrower proposal, not an owner prohibition on imports
purpose: Measure exact owned-Job process identities and strict refusal during registered source checks and CPU-only import statements; no assumed culprit, model execution or native qualification
scientific_rationale: Attempt004 recorded framework_import_attempt but no subsequent model operation. Pure source checks cannot exclude a distinct transient framework-import child. A sequential before/after import observation is a bounded resolving experiment, not another native source repair round.
requires_before_probe: Root freezes one separate implementation and its source commit, this contract, exact registry and all receipt identities
Independent operations review of frozen source, no-model/no-CUDA boundary, exact Job observations/notifications, telemetry and cleanup
Scientific source review verifies this fixed two-phase scope and correct incomplete-evidence behavior
Fresh unchanged host admission, one canonical host-wide worker lease and a60-second reservation charged to current epoch/rolling limits
No automatic rerun, active native job, native source edit, executable-registry broadening or qualification promotion

runtime.identity_limit: Selected source files, executable hashes and versions bind this import experiment; this is not a claim that every compiled DLL or transitive dependency has been independently audited

registry_association: Exactly the preserved native contract's .exe entries under its existing slash/case normalization; no added executable is permitted. Freeze canonical normalized map hash before implementation review.
source_binding: Also retain all preserved native source/runtime pins. Check source-only files and registered executables without reading or hashing any model asset. Bind new harness/observer/contract code before launch; record actual transitive module identities and import milestones without opening model assets.

environment.recording_limit: Record only declared noncredential settings; do not dump unrelated environment or tokens

phases.snapshot_schedule: Bootstrap1, repeated8 separated by at least0.05seconds, final1; fixed schedule with phase begin/end receipts

phases.fidelity: Actual native worker imports torch then resolves these two Transformers symbols. Plain transformers import is lazy and alone is not equivalent. Extra package-only milestone permits phase localization; no instances are constructed.
phases.transitive_imports: Record imported modules including incidental tokenizers/safetensors modules; importing definitions is distinct from tokenizer, safetensors file, model or tensor execution. No such API may be invoked by the experiment.

boundary.CUDA_state_observation: After torch import, read torch.cuda module dictionary's existing _initialized flag without calling a CUDA API; fail CPU scope if initialized. Record available/unavailable state per import milestone, not a forecast.
boundary.GPU_side_effect_observation: External reviewed nvidia-smi/NVML telemetry is observational; owned worker GPU participation is a CPU-scope violation, not allowed compute. Retain before/after and sampled observations; absence of a sampled entry alone is not proof of zero transient CUDA activity.
boundary.strict_API_boundary: Implementation/operations review must establish how forbidden CUDA availability/init and model/tensor operations are rejected or observed before execution without changing pinned library code. An import that requires forbidden operations must stop or remain unexecuted; do not silently suppress the operation and call it an unmodified replay. Python/internal C-side-effect coverage limitations must be explicit.

existing_helpers_invoked_unchanged: native.current_windows_job_witness and query-only noninheritable transfer, close before phases
native.drain_owned_job and strict last-handle/empty-tree exit proof

observations.notifications: Independent operations reviewer must validate exact owned Job process-creation/exit notifications, installed before resume; notifications and polling do not alter native membership policy
observations.capture_before_guard: Durably record all exact Job PIDs and every resolvable raw identity before each unchanged strict member/RSS guard, including unregistered/mismatched/vanished members, with no filtering
fields: wall/monotonic timestamps, phase/import step and complete exact Job PID list
PID and creation time or explicit unavailable reason
executable path, normalized registry key, actual SHA256 or explicit hashing failure
expected path/hash, path-known and hash-matches separately
explicit exact-Job membership and notification IDs
identity at guard begin and guard result/exception, with linked raw observation IDs
import attempt/completion/error, source/runtime identities and actually imported module manifest
CPU/CUDA boundary observations and any incomplete side-effect coverage
observations.binary_hash_bound: Hash only observed executable identities, individually at most64MiB and at most256MiB distinct executable bytes in the probe; exceeding the bound yields explicit unavailable coverage and strict refusal, never whitelist bypass
observations.coverage: Short-lived/unresolvable notification members remain explicit gaps. Instrumentation and hashing can change timing; no exhaustive-inventory or original-cause claim from sampling alone. No culprit inferred from merely coincident import timing.

limits.cost: Conservatively charge all contained worker/observer elapsed time against current epoch and rolling reservation; retain failures and review cost, no budget reset
limits.uncertain_outcome: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with full reservation held until independent reconciliation; no duplicate launch
limits.cleanup: Only exact probe-owned Job/tree may be drained or closed; unrelated processes untouched

outcomes: OBSERVED_IDENTITY_REFUSAL: exact retained identity/path/hash mismatch and guard/phase association; authorizes no executable and establishes no original-run cause by itself
COMPLETED_FIXED_CPU_IMPORT_PHASES: only specified import/source-check paths completed under bounded observed identities and boundary controls; no native qualification
BOUNDARY_VIOLATION_OR_INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: preserve partial evidence, failure and cost; no cause or zero-CUDA claim
REFUSAL_NOT_REPRODUCED: original cause remains unresolved; no repeat or native retry
restart_condition: Quarantine persists after this resolving experiment. Any proposed operational change must be explicitly registered as a new bounded milestone with fresh source/evidence review, preserve old native code/failures, and meet unchanged numerical/resource gates. This is not a fourth repair of the old candidate.
